arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) holds,(select group_concat(state||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) holds,(select group_concat(state||":"||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where b.status<>"confirmed" or b.booking_id like "bkg_6be4%"

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b where b.status<>"confirmed" or ck=0 or ob<>"delivered"

select event_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,30) p from outbox where status<>"delivered" and payload not like "%schema_version\": 1%" union all select "cfg",key,value,"" from service_config where service="checkin"

select (select count(*) from bookings where status="pending") pend,(select count(*) from bookings where status="confirmed") conf,(select count(*) from checkins) ck,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) ck,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b where ck=0 or ch is null or ch<>"captured" or ob is null or ob<>"delivered"
select "fh" k,flight_id a,fare_cents b,* from fare_holds
